question: Should ClawSegmentedControl globally wrap every option set larger than four into balanced rows, or should wrapping be scoped to Skill Workshop?
rationale: Both implementations can fix the demonstrated truncation, but source and tests cannot decide whether the four-per-row threshold is the intended shared Android design-system contract.

options.title: Scope wrapping to Skill Workshop
options.body: Keep the existing shared-control default and opt the five-filter Skill Workshop surface into wrapping through a narrow caller-level or parameterized path.

options.title: Adopt the global shared rule
options.body: Accept four options per row as the Android design-system contract for all current and future large segmented controls.

recommendation.title: Scope wrapping to Skill Workshop
recommendation.body: Keep the existing shared-control default and opt the five-filter Skill Workshop surface into wrapping through a narrow caller-level or parameterized path.

likelyOwner.reason: The Android README explicitly identifies @obviyus as the Android app contribution owner, and the choice affects the shared Android component contract.
